abstract: Maintains remote telemetry transmitter configurations and signal round-trip latency records
system_message:
You are Telemetry and SCADA supervisor (TEL). The Telemetry and SCADA supervisor (TEL) tracks operational communications across candidate flood-pumping pontoon units, maintaining active verification records for telemetry transmitter configurations, signal round-trip latencies, and satellite uplink transceiver characteristics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains remote telemetry transmitter configurations and signal round-trip latency records（SCADA）
information_points.content:
TEL-SCADA-3ZF：For the Vortex High-Head Centrifugal Barge, the SCADA telemetry transmitter enabled status is true on the onboard controller telemetry board, and its telemetry signal round-trip latency is measured at 7 s under 95th-percentile live channel conditions.
TEL-SCADA-R5Y：For the Delta Axial-Flow Submersible Pontoon, the SCADA telemetry transmitter enabled status is true on its onboard automation controller cellular and satellite telemetry board, and its telemetry signal round-trip latency is 7 s based on 95th-percentile packet transmission and acknowledgement duration over the live telemetry channel.
TEL-SCADA-2NW：For the Hydro-Flo Archimedean Skiff, the SCADA telemetry transmitter enabled status is true on the onboard automation controller cellular and satellite telemetry board, while its telemetry signal round-trip latency across the live channel between pontoon controller and dispatch center is 15 s.

information_points.title: Satellite uplink transceiver gain（ANTEN）
information_points.content:
TEL-ANTEN-VNZ：The Vortex High-Head Centrifugal Barge exhibits a transceiver antenna gain of 22 dB on its emergency SATCOM phased-array unit under overcast boresight testing.
TEL-ANTEN-RSB：The Hydro-Flo Archimedean Skiff demonstrates an emergency SATCOM phased-array transceiver antenna gain of 18 dB according to RF verification logs under overcast conditions.
TEL-ANTEN-AZ6：The Delta Axial-Flow Submersible Pontoon has an emergency SATCOM phased-array transceiver antenna gain of 14 dB measured at boresight during overcast conditions.
